research_evidence.origin: artifact://66, complete UTF-8 JSON with one terminal LF

input_policy: Whole original mono PCM16 WAV at 16000 Hz. No crop, concatenation, silence insertion, gain, normalization, resampling or time compression. File sample zero is local only; filename times are not a certified dialogue clock.
review_level: Limited automatic actual-source review: all four P1 human references and semantic targets corroborated by corrected no-hints Qwen ASR; supplied-text endpoint proposals compared with actual waveform at declared 80ms timestamp granularity. No listening. SAPI mismatch and invalid initial Qwen observation retained. No exact phonetic endpoint, clean speaker-separation or T1 common-origin claim.

automatic_review.method: File-only independent en-US dictation; no transcript or hotword hints, one synchronous recognition per source file. Inputs hashed before/after unchanged. No provider or benchmark-app calls.
automatic_review.result: All four first recognitions substantially disagree with released text at low confidence (0.0113–0.1634). Does not establish reference accuracy and is not proof source transcripts are wrong. No audible acceptance or certified endpoint credit.
automatic_review.failure_scope: Initial observation failed before recognition because Get-FileHash was unavailable; corrected procedure used .NET hashing. Failure retained, no source change.

review_policy: R2 does not impose a mandatory human-listening gate. Agreement among released human source text, actual waveform/source checks and independent no-hints ASR may support explicitly limited automatic review. No listening is a disclosure, not by itself a rejection. Hold unresolved content, leakage and endpoint claims on concrete evidence; forced alignment alone cannot independently verify text. The dialogue/common-origin T1 gate is unchanged.

stronger_automatic_review.method: Whole native files, gain 1, generic transcription instruction only, no language/reference/context hints. Fresh offline CPU process per file at 2 threads; no benchmark app/provider. All four actual audio encodings and generated transcriptions observed, exit 0, source hashes unchanged.
stronger_automatic_review.comparison: Three normalized-exact full references; main3 differs only by a semantically preserving definite article. All required question/request concepts corroborated, no extra substantive text detected. Human source references are not replaced.
stronger_automatic_review.limits: Automatic not human and not disjoint from evaluated Qwen family. Transcript agreement is not source separation, a guarantee of no quiet leakage or exact speech-end timing.
stronger_automatic_review.invalid_prior_reason: Empty prompt selected interactive chat; stdin EOF caused exit 0 without audio inference. Retained as invalid, not source/model failure.

endpoint_review.method: Four original full-file PCM inputs and separately corroborated source references; raw word predictions, no repairs, gain/time edits or playback changes. Exit 0 at 2 CPU threads. Actual waveform compared in 5ms min/max display bins.
endpoint_review.limits: One-grid-bin neighborhoods are proposal/sensitivity regions, not calibrated error bounds. Main endpoints sit near terminal decay with low-energy tails; development endpoint is within 80ms of file edge with remaining terminal energy. File end, alignment end and uncertainty remain separate.

blocker_evidence.missing_clock_and_origin: Inspected release has no verified dialogue/recording map, recorder offsets/drift, reset semantics or shared origin. Semantic adjacency and both microphone sides are positive candidate evidence, not a synchronization certificate.
blocker_evidence.missing_intervening_audio: Complete original archive has 12314 utterance WAVs and 8 small code/metadata files, not the 98 unsegmented recordings described in paper §§3.1–3.2, raw annotations or clock logs. Paper postprocessing excludes all-[UNK] utterances: omitted intervals are not proven silent. No clips have been stitched and no silences invented.

recycled_session_ids.meaning: Not unique dialogues; split-local IDs and session_id alone are not join keys.

recurrent_speakers.meaning: Reserve connected groups across original people, all case types and derivatives, not merely filenames/upstream splits.

concrete_same_stem_timestamp_reset.interpretation: Observed reset within same stem; [INFERENCE] recording-part reset or naming issue requires authoritative source mapping, not sorting/stitching.

sample_clock.use: Actual frame counts, not rounded duration text, govern candidate intervals.

blocker_evidence.P3: 6 main + 1 development remain unmet; 10.44-second train/06251 is an unclassified compact explanatory candidate, not forced P3 credit. No invented minimum duration threshold.
blocker_evidence.T1: No parent accepted: exactly 9 main + 4 development remain unmet. Do not start dependent JA/KO production T1 or substitute EN/ZH TTS, shrink cells or redistribute weights.
